name: calastone-relationship-snapshot
description: Scopes ES module semantics to this feature folder only. The repository root stays CommonJS for api/*.js and scripts/*.js — adding "type": "module" there would break every serverless handler. Node resolves the nearest package.json, so this file lets `node --test` import these modules without the MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning. It has no effect in the browser, which loads these files via <script type="module">.
